test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Lalla, Bablu, Mahesh, Abdul, Arif, Surekha and Kiku are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Lalla sits 2nd to the right of Bablu. Mahesh sits 3rd to the left of Abdul. Arif sits to the immediate left of Abdul. Surekha is an immediate neighbour of Bablu. Kiku is not an immediate neighbour of Surekha. Who sits third to the right of Abdul?
solution:
Given:

Lalla, Bablu, Mahesh, Abdul, Arif, Surekha and Kiku are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Mahesh sits 3rd to the left of Abdul.

Arif sits to the immediate left of Abdul.

Lalla sits 2nd to the right of Bablu.

Surekha is an immediate neighbour of Bablu.
